title: Trump and New York Mayor Meet at Gracie Mansion
seoTitle: Trump and NYC Mayor Meet at Gracie Mansion
subtitle: US President and the new New York mayor hold talks in meeting scheduled for UN General Assembly week
excerpt: Donald Trump and Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani will meet at Gracie Mansion in New York during UN week to discuss infrastructure, immigration, and.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Donald Trump will meet with New York Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani at Gracie Mansion this Monday, shortly before his speech at the United Nations General Assembly. The meeting takes place during the city's intense international agenda and brings to the forefront topics such as infrastructure projects, immigration policies, and public safety.

The meeting at Gracie Mansion during UN week

Trump's visit to Gracie Mansion comes as New York hosts the UN General Assembly, attracting leaders from around the world and prompting heightened security measures. The US president arrives to speak with Mamdani before his address at the UN.

Key agenda items discussed

In previous meetings, Mamdani focused on infrastructure projects requiring federal funding, such as the development of Sunnyside Yard, a 180-acre site in Queens that would require around $21 billion in subsidies. The topic is expected to be revisited, alongside issues of immigration, cost of living, and public safety.

History of meetings between Trump and Mamdani

This will be the third face-to-face meeting between the two leaders since their first meeting in the Oval Office in November 2025, and the second in February 2026, when Mamdani presented a housing plan for New York. On both occasions, topics included immigration, real estate, and energy tariffs.

Previous presidential visits to Gracie Mansion

Trump has already been to Gracie Mansion twice: in 2003, for the wedding of then-Mayor Rudy Giuliani, and in 2007, for a book launch party for Representative Charles Rangel, both hosted by then-Mayor Bloomberg.

Local political context

While Mamdani seeks federal support for municipal projects, Governor Kathy Hochul declared she has no plans to meet with Trump this week, despite maintaining regular contact with the president.

With information from CNN, ABC7 New York.
